focus.name: InteractionAnchor_ForwardSpawn
focus.purpose: Bound the interaction-anchor forward spawner immediately before the anchored movement callback family.

behavior: Calls Actor_FindFreeSlotExtendedForward and returns when the extended actor pool has no free slot.
Copies the source X/Y words at A1+0x02/A1+0x04 to the new actor with an independent +0x10 minus low-five-bit PRNG offset on each axis.
Uses the shared interaction-anchor movement callback family for the spawned response actor's subsequent movement behavior.
